# Bellory Pharma / Hi Line Pro Care

> Official Egyptian online store for Hi Line Pro Care personal-care products and roll-on deodorants. The store serves customers in Egypt and accepts cash on delivery. Orders are reviewed and confirmed by the seller.

## Key facts

- Brand: Hi Line Pro Care
- Ownership: Hi Line is a brand owned by Bellory Pharma
- Market: Egypt
- Currency: Egyptian pound (EGP)
- Payment: Cash on delivery
- Product focus: Roll-on deodorants and daily personal-care products
- Product claims and ingredients should be taken only from each official product page.
